title: Aristotle's passage on the ancestors' belief in divinity
summary: James Madden tells of Aristotle's passage on the ancestors' belief in divinity, about ancient Greece at not stated, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And and then and then he says, "This shows that our ancestors, our most ancient ancestors were not wrong when they posited that there was a divinity surrounding nature

plain: James Madden, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, recalls a passage by Aristotle, the ancient Greek philosopher. According to Madden, Aristotle says this shows that our most ancient ancestors were not wrong when they believed there was a divinity surrounding nature. Madden brings it up to suggest that very old beliefs in intelligent powers around us may have been on to something.
